name: AppUpdateKit
description: AppUpdateKit is a PowerShell toolkit for Intune Win32 app updates that ask the user first: a consent popup, postpone options with a countdown, progress and result notifications, and a restart prompt with a deadline. A GUI Builder generates the install, uninstall, detection and requirement scripts for each app. The Builder and full manual are in Dutch, while the popup texts shown to users are customizable.
author: Fonfey

securityCheck.aiSummary: The AppUI-Launcher.ps1 code implements per-user UI interactions for app updates with scheduled tasks and VBScript launchers to run child PowerShell scripts. Notable security concerns include: policy-bypass execution and hidden process launching, which could be abused for stealth execution; ensure strict access controls, script signing, auditing of created scheduled tasks, and minimize use of bypass. No remote code fetch, no credential theft, and no hardcoded secrets observed here.
